correctness.rationale: The two opinion-count birth–death rates give exactly LZ=ε(1/2−Z), L(X−Y)=−(2−ε)(X−Y), Γ(Z)=s[ε/2+(1−ε)(x+y−2xy)]/4. Dynkin’s Ld² equation makes fast disagreement negligible in integrated rescaled drift, with jumps ≤1/(2 min(a,b)), so the martingale problem converges to Gf=λ(1/2−z)f′+z(1−z)f″/4 with absorbing λ=0 boundary. Stationary cross-spin W=c s/[2(1−c²)+c²s], same-part cW and Var(Z)=[s+(2+2c−cs)W]/16 follow by pair generator; λ>0 invariant Jacobi diffusion has Beta(2λ,2λ), while variance gives λ=0/infinity endpoints. Inspected verify.py exact rational finite-state checker; independently substituted (a,b,ε)=(1,1,1/3),(2,3,1/3),(4,6,1/3), producing positive variance and cross-covariance consistent with formula. Finite checks do not prove the process limit.
